description: This file contains functions for pruning and filtering Kubernetes resource schemas, specifically removing or preserving object fields based on structural schema options.

methods.name: PruneWithOptions
methods.description: Removes object fields not specified in the schema, with options to control behavior and track unknown fields.

methods.name: Prune
methods.description: Simplified version of PruneWithOptions with default options.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Recursively prunes object fields based on schema properties and options.

methods.name: skipPrune
methods.description: Recursively skips pruning certain fields based on schema options.
